names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Μαρτίου, «Οσία Πιαμούν η Παρθένος», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 3 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Света Пиамука Мисирка.“, with Света left off, which is not a rank. Мисирка is kept: it is the epithet of her country, the Egyptian woman, and not a rank or a see, and the heading carries no rank word at all.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 3 марта ст. ст., name page 2645, «Пиама Александрийская, дева, прп.», with the rank words left off. The day’s own line declines the name. The toponymic is part of the name the calendar’s index carries and stays, and so is the calendar’s own rank of virgin, which is left out of the form itself. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Пиамы девы (337).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαρτίου — «Οσία Πιαμούν η Παρθένος»

attestations.note: The page puts her in Egypt in the fourth century, orphaned of her father young and raised by her Christian mother, and gives no year, no city, no monastery, no relic and no hymn. It prints the distich «Κροσσωτὰ χρυσᾶ Πιαμοῦν μελαμφόρος, / Τὰς ἀρετὰς ἄπεισιν ἠμφιεσμένη», which sets her black habit against the golden fringes of the psalm. It does not name the enemies who besieged her birthplace, and carries no etymology block over her name. No other bearer of this name stands anywhere in the corpus.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.03.2026 (3. март ст. ст.) — „Света Пиамука Мисирка.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, five sentences long. It is read as this folder's saint on the menologion day, the country and the manner of life: a virgin of Egypt kept on 3 March who lived as an ascetic in her mother's house. The two accounts share almost no incident — saint.gr has her orphaned young, giving alms with her mother and lifting a siege by her name, where the Prologue has her refuse marriage, eat every second day and receive the gift of foresight — and the difference is recorded rather than reconciled. The Prologue gives her repose as about 377, which the folder's `floruit` of the fourth century had no death beside; the death was added and the floruit left alone.

floruit.note: saint.gr gives her the fourth century; days.pravoslavie.ru gives no century of its own but a year, 337, which falls inside it, and the Охридски пролог gives neither.

death.note: The two readings are kept and neither is chosen. saint.gr, from which this folder was written, has her die about 377; days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 3 марта ст. ст. «Прп. Пиамы девы (337).» and its life «Святая мирно отошла ко Господу в 337 году». No third source has been read for her, and the two years being each other’s digits reversed is not a reason to prefer either.
